top_signals.title: Fletcher Building Waits on Meaningful Recovery in NZ Demand
top_signals.summary: New Zealand’s largest construction materials company Fletcher Building Ltd. doesn’t expect a meaningful recovery in its markets until 2027, adding to signs of muted economic growth over the second half of this year.
